introduction: Trace Ezallixxel's three-ingredient legacy return and understand the unavailable auction. Current preparation, service availability, ambient lore and accepted history have distinct roles.
orientation: Ezallixxel accepts the still-beating heart of Bel, the orb of unmaking and the mystic runed stone tablet together for the scroll of Power. The three exact preparations lead to one accepted exchange. His native recipe does not require an extra arbitrary artifact or a previous auction purchase.

Bel can carry the heart in Avernus, and the Dark Prince can carry the orb in the fortress of Hell. Those are selected outside source leads. Supplied ingredients can fit the return without proving your own boss victory, first recovery or source custody.

No current producer for the required tablet was found in the reviewed reset and compiled source inventory. An existing or supplied tablet can fit the recipe, but this journal cannot promise a working starter. The scroll is a legacy reward; obtaining or reading it does not establish a new ability.

Ezallixxel also has an epic training service, assigned during normal startup. PRACTICE Epic Power follows that service's own requirements. Epic skill purchases are currently unavailable while economic accounting is active; training is separate from the scroll exchange.

The auctioneer answers hi, hello, goblin, dwarf and spider. These describe advertised choices. The goblin and spider native recipes have the same 10,000-copper payment and reward identity, and no dwarf recipe is defined. The reward item is missing from the active object catalog.

The auction purchase is currently unavailable while economic accounting is active. Do not pay in expectation of a working companion purchase. Its journal card retains one historical accepted receipt identity, rather than inventing three purchases; it is excluded from potential dailies.

Ask the scrawny drow hi or hello for the warning about the city. The drow's warning, Ezallixxel's ambient projection and the spores' growth messages are context. Hearing them does not record a rescue, a harvest, a conversation achievement or an accepted return.

A flesh golem at the city entrance can carry the iron key for the northern gate. Current key possession and shared door access are preparation. The cliff descent, secret rubble routes and falls have their own movement rules; none is an invented personal-history gate for the exchange.

The elder brain has a separate Spatial Focus training service under normal startup. Its loading room, follower and surrounding loot rooms need builder qualification: normal wandering cannot take it into the adjacent NO_MOB rooms. Do not treat finding another copy of its lore or loot as your own victory.

The clothing shop, metalsmith, banker and inn reception are local context and services. Current accounting restrictions apply to purchases. They do not create additional native quest receipts or a required chain of shopping, rental and banking.

Carry each exact ingredient loose. Readiness describes current inventory; worn, nested or similarly named items do not replace it. A recorded accepted exchange remains complete after its ingredients are spent. All new journal and quest credit requires active, ready accounting. Daily rollover does not restock shared loot or restore an unavailable service.
